description: Term deposit interest rates of Romanian banks, from Agregator.ro, updated daily from what each bank publishes. Without a term: the highest rate for each term (1, 3, 6, 12 months, 2 years, 3+ years). With a term: every bank ranked by rate. With a bank: all of that bank's current deposits. Includes net interest after the 10% tax and each offer's conditions. In Romanian.

amount.description: Amount to deposit, for the net interest and amount limits. Default 20000 RON or 5000 EUR/USD.

audience.description: Offers only for new clients, pensioners or children are left out unless asked for here. Default all (open to anyone).

bank.description: Only this bank, by name or short name, e.g. "BCR", "Banca Transilvania", "ING".

limit.description: Rows when ranking one term. Default 10.

no_conditions.description: Only offers with no requirements (new money, salary at the bank, an account package, card spend).

term.description: Term in months: 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, or 36 for 3 years or more. Each covers nearby terms (6 covers 5–8 months).

title: Dobânzi la depozite
